news.title: Susan Collins Says Rival’s ‘Oh, Shut Up’ Comment Reflects How He Treats Women
news.summary: Ms. Collins, a Republican running in a crucial race, called the debate remark by her opponent, Troy Jackson, “very telling.” Mr. Jackson has defended his comment, and his campaign said Ms. Collins had run a campaign based on personal attacks.
